statement: A consumer may cancel a distance or off-premises contract at any time in the cancellation period without giving any reason; for a service contract the period ends 14 days after the day the contract is entered into, and for a sales contract 14 days after the day the goods come into the physical possession of the consumer or a person the consumer identifies (the last lot or piece where goods ordered together arrive in multiple lots, but the FIRST delivery where the contract is for regular delivery of goods over a period) (Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013, SI 2013/3134, regs 29(1), 30).
caveat: Regulations 27 and 28 take whole contract classes outside the cancellation right; regulation 31 extends the period, up to 12 months beyond its normal end, where the trader fails to give the required cancellation information; and regulation 37 ends the right for digital content not on a tangible medium once supply begins with the consumer's express consent and acknowledgment that the right is lost. The Regulations govern business-to-consumer contracts. This repo does not classify a specific contract or flow.
